review.calibrationAction: Apply LoL v0.3.8 before every actionable draft recommendation. Positive underdog kill handicaps are NO BET when the underdog lacks durable space creation, its carries must enter the opponent's strongest control range, and two or more counters attack the same engage or damage-delivery route without two observed structured-fight conversions.
